sequence.description: Input protein sequence as a single-letter string of standard amino acids. Only ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY are accepted. Gaps, unknown residues (X), and ambiguous codes (B/Z/U/O/J) are not supported. Length is capped by the scoring checkpoint's positional-embedding size; longer chains must be scored in segments. Preferred over structure_path.

structure_path.description: Path or TOS URI to an input protein structure in PDB or mmCIF format. Used only when sequence is not provided. The model extracts standard amino-acid sequences and queries the MSA service automatically.

custom_output_path.description: Resolved output destination. Set by framework - see gateway.source.ApiSource.resolve_output_dest().
